name: io.github.justice8096/sagemath-mcp-server
description: MCP server wrapping SageMath's full computer algebra system - 10 symbolic-math tools for LLMs.

environmentVariables.name: SAGE_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Per-call SageMath timeout in milliseconds. Default 120000.

environmentVariables.name: SAGE_DOCKER_IMAGE
environmentVariables.description: Docker image used when SageMath is not installed locally. Default sagemath/sagemath:latest.

environmentVariables.name: SAGE_EXECUTION_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Where SageMath runs: 'auto' (default: Docker if installed and running, otherwise local sage), 'local', or 'docker'. Docker mode runs each call in a throwaway container with no network.

environmentVariables.name: HOST
environmentVariables.description: Interface the HTTP transport listens on. Default 127.0.0.1.

environmentVariables.name: API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Required when TRANSPORT=http (at least 16 characters); the server will not start in HTTP mode without it. Clients send it as X-API-Key or Authorization: Bearer. Ignored for stdio.
